author: root
finding: R3 slow HTTP output escaped request-budget lifetime
changes: HTTP connection cap 96; all HTTP request slots remain charged until backend and response both settle.
Shared 32 MiB retained-response budget covers JSON and static assets; static bytes reserved before file read.
Response reservations release on finish/close, with a 15-second write deadline. Error response admission fails closed without recursive allocation.
Abandoning a browser request does not free admission for retained backend work.
regressionEvidence: Eight paused real sockets with three sequential 6 MiB replies each stay within the global output cap; excess output rejected; capacity recovers after close.
Forty-eight abandoned pending backend reads still consume admission until backend settlement.
A real slow socket is destroyed at the 15-second response deadline.
testDevelopmentNotes: Initial deadline fixture used a 10 MiB dispatcher result which correctly hit its separate response cap; corrected to three valid 6 MiB replies. One invocation listed a nonexistent static test and the runner correctly refused to start.
